name: tancode
description: A lightweight, local-first coding companion that helps developers learn technical concepts while vibe coding and understand errors without relying on their coding agent for every explanation.

tancode.ollama.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the local Ollama server. Tancode never calls external AI services.

tancode.ollama.model.description: Ollama model used for explanations. Must already be pulled — see `ollama list`.

tancode.maxSourceBytes.description: Files larger than this many bytes are not sent to the model.

tancode.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for each Ollama request in milliseconds.

tancode.fallbackToRuleBased.description: Show the deterministic rule-based explanation (clearly labelled, not AI-generated) when the model is unavailable.
